title: Convex Games Have Nonempty Core
body_html:
Convex Games Have Nonempty Core

Theorem. If a finite TU game is convex, then its core is nonempty.
proof_html:
Sketch

Convexity implies the balancedness inequalities required by Bondareva-Shapley. Applying [[game_theory.cooperative_game.bondareva_shapley]] then gives nonemptiness of the core.

Lean Status

The Lean module defines the relevant core and convex-game predicates. This theorem remains a blueprint target depending on the Bondareva-Shapley route.

References

  • [MSZ Ch.17, Thm 17.55] Maschler, Solan, Zamir, Game Theory.
